description: Nicaragua's Instituto Nacional de Información de Desarrollo keeps the 2005 Population and Housing Census online as a REDATAM database. Dwelling records hold the type of dwelling, material of the outer walls, roof and floor, the source of lighting, the water supply, tenure, and the distance, means of transport and travel time to the nearest health centre or post. Household records add the type of toilet and whether it is shared, cooking fuel, refuse disposal, and ownership of items such as fixed and mobile telephones, cable television, a computer, an internet connection, air conditioning, cars, motorcycles and boats. The geography goes from department to municipality, comarca and neighbourhood or community, so tables can be run for small rural areas. Format and access: free online frequencies, cross tabulations and area lists, with Excel and PDF export buttons on the output pages and a downloadable dictionary file. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the data are from 2005; INIDE announced a new population and housing census, but no results were found on the pages read; the dictionary also carries later survey variables that are not part of the census. Simulation uses: comarca level wall and roof materials for hurricane and earthquake exposure, and lighting and water sources, and access time to health posts, for service and emergency planning. Related records: the IV national agricultural census microdata from INIDE and the ECLAC REDATAM hub.
